Here’s how you can do more.
Maximize your investment in Recorded Future with bespoke onboarding, enablement, training, and 24/7 support that doesn’t sleep…so you can.
Onboarding
Our onboarding service ensures your team is set up for long-term success from day one. Partner with a Technical Project Manager to guide you through product configuration, aligning key objectives with optimized data workflows, tailored use cases, and seamless integrations. We provide hands-on training, enablement, and alert configuration, so your team is fully equipped to hit the ground running and grow with confidence.
Customer Success
Our customer service team helps you unlock the full potential of Recorded Future. Your dedicated CSM (Customer Success Manager) works closely with you to align the Platform with your goals, optimize workflows, and access expert support—ensuring continuous value and long-term growth.
Training
Strengthen your skills and maximize the impact of Recorded Future with ongoing training designed for analysts of all levels. Our comprehensive courses cover platform fundamentals, advanced threat intelligence techniques, and tailored learning paths to fit your team’s goals.
Recorded Future University offers:
Structured learning journeys for all our product offerings
Workflows to help maximize your use of our product
Industry and tradecraft content
Exclusive access to webinars and in-person workshops
CPE Credits - Recorded Future University partners with ISC2 to provide continuing professional education credits.
Learn more
24/7 Product Support
Security isn’t a 9-5 job.
Whether it's via email, web form, or our phone support line, our product support team is available at all hours to handle any and all platform and data issues - from service disruptions to configuration troubleshooting. Our various support channels can easily be found 24/7 through the Portal on our support site.
Community
Join Recorded Future’s client-exclusive space for collaboration and intelligence sharing with other security professionals. Accessible through the Portal, this community lets users exchange best practices, workflows, and actionable insights to strengthen threat detection and response.
